day counts, tax tables, bank matching, thresholds.
No model computes pay. Models never add numbers

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Run on every proposed grant, BEFORE anything posts,
and on the calendar triggers

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1 · 409A safe-harbour window
grant_date minus valuation_date lte 12 months
REBUTTABLE PRESUMPTION, not a rule
(verified: 26 CFR 1.409A-1(b)(5)(iv)(B))

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1b · second limb: ALSO fails if information after
the valuation may materially affect value.
Any material-event hit always escalates

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2 · strike_cents gte fmv_cents of the 409A in force
on the grant date (verified: 1.409A-1(b)(5)(i)(A)(1),
and IRC 422(b)(4) for ISOs)

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3 · ISO $100,000 limit (verified: IRC 422(d))
per employee and calendar year: sum tranche shares
x grant-date FMV over tranches FIRST exercisable
that year, in grant order · uses FMV, not strike

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Excess over $100,000 treated as NSO:
ISO / NSO split per tranche · early-exercise grant
counts in full in grant year · acceleration re-runs

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4 · Rule 701(e) (verified: 17 CFR 230.701(e))
sum over ANY consecutive 12 months, BEFORE each grant:
over $10M → enhanced disclosure due · warn at 80%
options count at grant, at exercise price (d)(3)

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4b · (d)(2) exemption cap, OMITTED by the spec:
greatest of $1M, 15% of total assets,
or 15% of the outstanding class

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
OUTPUT RULE: a compliance failure ESCALATES to a
human and is PERSISTED as a flag, but NEVER blocks
expense recognition (accounting follows the grant as made)

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
event equity.compliance_flag (→ audit)
persistent flag on the grant, check name,
citation, inputs, n

div.style: color: rgb(63, 37, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CFO and outside counsel
decide what to do about a flag

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
grant (PROPOSED table): employee_id, type, shares,
strike_cents, board_approval_date, vest_start,
cliff_months, vest_months, gdfv_cents_per_share

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Inputs from the assumptions file ONLY: 409A FMV,
strike, expected term (simplified-method midpoint,
UNVERIFIED), peer volatility, Treasury rate, 0 dividends

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Grant-date fair value: Black-Scholes in code
→ gdfv_cents_per_share · the model picks no input

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Attribution election (policy fact, approved):
straight-line or graded ? (ASC 718-10-35-8,
secondary source)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Straight-line: total award cost
evenly over the whole service period

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Graded: each vest_tranche treated as its own
award → front-loaded expense

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Floor in BOTH methods: cumulative cost at any
date gte grant-date value of the vested portion

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ASSUMPTION (policy election, ASC 718-10-35-3):
forfeitures recognised AS THEY OCCUR · no estimated
rate, deterministic · stored as a fact with approver

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
sbc_schedule(grant_id, month, expense_cents, method)
+ vest_tranche(grant_id, vest_date, shares, status)
integer cents · last month absorbs rounding

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Monthly run · ONE stock_comp_expense proposal
per period:
Dr Stock-comp expense (by department)
Cr APIC (additional paid-in capital)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
fact candidate: predicate employment_end,
value = last day, source_trace_ids = Slack notice
(record_fact_candidate)

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Kernel E: end date corroborated by a SECOND source
(payroll register or HRIS) before any reversal posts ?

div.style: color: rgb(63, 37, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
HR owner in Slack · asked ONCE ·
answer stored as a scoped fact

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
event hr.departure_detected
employee.end_date set · intent_id carried

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Payroll final pay: prorated salary to end_date
+ accrued PTO payout per policy
Dr Salaries expense · Dr Accrued PTO liability
Cr Accrued payroll (cash on pay date)

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Final-pay due date = STATE-scoped fact known ?
(federal law sets no immediate deadline, verified DOL)
unknown → escalate once

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Unvested forfeited: every vest_tranche with
vest_date after end_date → status forfeited

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Forfeiture reversal (current OPEN period):
reversal = recognised_to_date minus gdfv(vested tranches)
Dr APIC · Cr Stock-comp expense
vested cost is NEVER reversed

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Stop future sbc_schedule rows · set exercise expiry
from the plan · ISO loses ISO status if exercised
more than 3 months after end (IRC 422(a)(2), UNVERIFIED)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
13-week forecast updated: payroll outflow drops from
next run · final pay inserted · exercise window
shown as a memo line, not an inflow

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
checklist_item: terminations processed
(close pack) · reporting gets flux lines
on payroll and stock comp

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Audit pack: reversal JE enters the sample ·
control test: no departed employee holds
approval authority after end_date

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Bank rec match (exercise notice trace or event
bankrec.unmatched): expected cash =
shares x strike_cents · bank credit must equal
it exactly · bank line matched once

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
shares exercised lte vested (unless
early_exercise) AND date lte exercise expiry ?
fail → BLOCK

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Exercise entry:
Dr Cash
Cr Common stock (par) · Cr APIC (excess over par)
→ exercise(id, grant_id, shares, cash_cents, bank_txn_id)

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: ISO or NSO ? (after the $100K split)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
NSO: event equity.nso_exercise →
payroll withholding touchpoint ·
no tax amount is computed here

div.style: color: rgb(63, 37, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Payroll owner / equity admin:
ISO vs NSO payroll-tax treatment
is flagged to a human, never decided

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Provider stable key = ACH originator company id,
never the descriptor string (A-09, H-3:
GUSTO PAYROLL vs GUSTO TAX COLLECTION)

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Register vs bank debit tie: sum(net) = net-pay debit ·
sum(ee_tax + er_tax) = tax debit · fee → expense ·
each bank line matched once · residual 0 cents

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Month-end accrual, day-count in CODE:
working days from last period_end to month end
x daily rate, per employee active on the date

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Employer taxes and benefits liabilities: SS 6.2% to the
$184,500 2026 wage base (base verified SSA), YTD tracked ·
Medicare 1.45% · FUTA first $7,000 (rates UNVERIFIED) ·
SUI and benefit rates from the policy memo

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
payroll_accrual entry:
Dr Salaries, employer tax and benefits expense
Cr Accrued payroll · Cr Payroll tax and benefits liab.
flagged to auto-reverse on day 1 (D-01 pattern, D-02)

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Hard rules: pay to anyone after end_date → BLOCK ·
payroll debit to an unknown originator id → BLOCK

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
forecast_line: payroll calendar in the 13-week
forecast, rebuilt from the active roster
(pay dates x net + tax debits)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
propose_entry + workpaper
kinds: payroll_accrual (in spec) · PROPOSED:
stock_comp_expense, forfeiture_reversal,
option_exercise, final_pay

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Kernel F·E·P·J + pack checks

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
F · schedule sums to grant-date fair value of
awards expected to vest (gdfv x shares) ·
cumulative gte vested floor

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
F · forfeiture reversal = recognised_to_date minus
gdfv(vested tranches): UNVESTED only, lte recognised,
vested cost never reversed ·
exercise cash = shares x strike

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
E + P · grant approved in a board consent that is
CITED (quote + trace_id) · period open: a July
termination found in August books in August ·
J: method and election facts active, approved

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: AUTO

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: PROPOSE

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: ESCALATE

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: REFUSE

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: BLOCK

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
AUTO · monthly expense, all facts in force → stock-comp JE
+ schedule workpaper · exercise cash = shares x strike → cash
and equity JE · register = debits, or descriptor changed but
originator same (A-09, H-3) · notified: nobody

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PROPOSE · new grant ties to consent, checks pass →
grant record + schedule · termination corroborated by two
sources → forfeiture reversal JE · notified: controller

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PROPOSE · ISO over $100K → ISO / NSO split per tranche
(equity admin, payroll) · Rule 701 at 80% → rolling-sum
workpaper (CFO, counsel) · month-end payroll_accrual with
reversal, AUTO once it climbs the ladder (controller)

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ESCALATE · 409A older than 12 months or material event ·
strike below FMV · Rule 701 would be crossed by this grant →
compliance flag, EXPENSE STILL RUNS · notified: CFO, counsel

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ESCALATE · termination seen only in Slack → question to
HR owner · final-pay due date unknown for the state (once) ·
debit differs from register → itemised difference (payroll
owner) · accrual not reversed D-02 (close owner)

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
BLOCK · exercise over vested shares or after expiry ·
expense run with an unapproved method · backdated grant ·
pay after end_date · unknown originator →
blocked_attempt row with rule name · notified: equity admin

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
REFUSE · asked: is this valuation defensible ? or
what tax does the holder owe ? → declines,
lists everywhere it looked · notified: CFO

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Post: gl_entry + gl_line (local ledger)
→ one-way QuickBooks mirror ·
material or new → controller agent (GPT)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Consumes (event table): hr.departure_detected ·
bankrec.unmatched · board.consent_ingested

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Emits: equity.forfeiture · equity.expense_revised (close,
reporting flux) · equity.exercise_expected (bank rec,
forecast memo line) · equity.nso_exercise (payroll) ·
equity.compliance_flag (audit)

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PROPOSED schema additions (spec 7 lacks them):
employee(id, state, start, end_date) ·
grant(...) · vest_tranche · valuation_409a ·
exercise · sbc_schedule

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PROPOSED: payroll_line(run_id, employee_id, gross,
ee_tax, er_tax, benefits, net) ·
blocked_attempt(decision_id, rule, at, evidence_json) ·
4 new Proposal.kind values

div.style: color: rgb(6, 43, 44) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
LEARNABLE (company tier facts, with approver):
department and account mapping · who confirms
terminations · the elections, stated once ·
originator ids · benefit rates · state final-pay facts

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
fact: predicate, value_json, scope_json,
valid_from, valid_to, learned_at, approved_by
→ applied automatically next time, asked once

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
NEVER LEARNED (universal tier = code + citation):
compliance thresholds, windows, statutory wording ·
tax rates and wage bases (versioned table) · volatility
or term · counsel said fine, widened past one grant

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
METRICS · TO BE MEASURED (nothing run yet):
grants scheduled · schedule-to-GL tie (cents) · days from
termination to reversal · over-accrual caught ($) ·
four checks run and flagged with n · Rule 701 headroom

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PAYROLL METRICS · TO BE MEASURED: runs tied to the
cent · accrual vs actual next run (abs error) ·
departures processed within one pay cycle ·
repeat questions (target 0) · exercises matched
